missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend whey from training goal alone; estimate dietary protein, clarify allergy/intolerance and assess renal or other relevant health context.
safety_exclusions: Do not promise muscle gain independent of resistance training and total diet.
Do not assume whey is required if food intake meets needs.
Do not recommend whey protein in milk-protein allergy.
professional_escalation_conditions: Chronic kidney disease, milk allergy, severe gastrointestinal symptoms, pregnancy or medically prescribed protein restriction.
population_and_context: Adults doing strength training who report low dietary protein; whey may be a convenient food-derived protein source when an actual intake gap is confirmed.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. If needed, calculate total daily protein from food and products using an appropriate life-stage/activity context; avoid duplicate products.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet discusses protein and exercise; individual needs vary and whey is not uniquely required.
